areas.t: Wednesday, October 28 and Thursday, October 29: Southerly to southwesterly winds throughout much of the period will recirculate regional pollutants into northeastern Ohio. Additionally, morning temperature inversions will trap pollutants near the ground. As a result, AQI levels will be low-Moderate
